switches.name: pac-url
switches.summary: also read this proxy auto-configuration script and say where it sends the target

switches.name: from
switches.summary: instead of a URL: write a report saved earlier with --json again, in the format asked for, without running anything. A single dash reads it from standard input

switches.name: format
switches.summary: how to write the report. Defaults to terminal

switches.name: out
switches.summary: where to write the report. A single dash means standard output, which is the default

switches.name: redact
switches.summary: mask host names, paths and user names. Credentials are masked with or without it

switches.name: in
switches.summary: diagnose from inside a running container

switches.name: image
switches.summary: diagnose from inside a throwaway container built from an image

switches.name: compare
switches.summary: show the host and the container side by side. Needs --in or --image

switches.name: quiet
switches.summary: keep the log on standard error down to failures

switches.name: verbose
switches.summary: say more on standard error about what is happening

switches.name: no-color
switches.summary: never colour the output. NO_COLOR in the environment does the same

switches.name: timeout
switches.summary: limit for the whole run in seconds, at least 0.001. Zero means no limit. Defaults to 60

switches.name: probe-timeout
switches.summary: limit for one layer in seconds, at least 0.001. Zero means no limit. Defaults to 10

switches.name: version
switches.summary: print the version of the tool and of every schema it emits

switches.name: license
switches.summary: print the licence, then the notices of the third party code in this binary

exitCodes.name: OK
exitCodes.meaning: everything that mattered was assessed and passed

exitCodes.name: USAGE
exitCodes.meaning: bad invocation syntax or an unknown flag

exitCodes.name: CONFIG
exitCodes.meaning: flags are valid on their own but contradictory or unsatisfiable

exitCodes.name: DIAGNOSIS
exitCodes.meaning: the run succeeded and found at least one failure

exitCodes.name: INCONCLUSIVE
exitCodes.meaning: no failure, but at least one thing could not be assessed

exitCodes.name: IO
exitCodes.meaning: the report could not be written

layers.name: Context
layers.summary: the machine itself - operating system, container, VPN, the clock, and the environment variables that decide trust and proxying

layers.name: Name resolution
layers.summary: what the name resolves to, seen both the way this system sees it and the way certdoctor sees it

layers.name: Proxy
layers.summary: which proxy will actually be used for this URL, and by which tool

layers.name: TCP
layers.summary: whether each resolved address accepts a connection, and how it refuses when it does not

layers.name: TLS
layers.summary: the handshake and the chain the server presented, including whether it was re-signed on the way here

layers.name: Trust matrix
layers.summary: which runtimes on this machine trust that chain, one row per installed instance
